name: Bloodmoss Poultice
material: a sprig of bloodmoss, which the spell consumes
text: Wakes the healing in a wad of bloodmoss and presses it to a wound. The target regains hit points over the next several seconds rather than all at once.

name: Bone Storm
text: A whirling column of bone splinters grinds anyone inside. The caster can drag it a few paces each second.

name: Bonechain
text: Chains of knotted bone burst from the ground around up to three creatures. Those who fail are held fast and feel the cold sapping them.

name: Bounty Mark
text: Marks a creature named on a bounty. The caster always knows its direction, and the town's bounty board shows where it was last seen.

name: Breachward
text: A shimmering plate of force seals a breach in the walls. Attackers must break the ward before they can pour through.

name: Call to Arms
text: Every bell in town rings at once. Militia and off-duty heroes inside the walls muster at the gate within moments and fight without fear while the bells ring.

name: Caravan Blessing
material: a ribbon tied to the lead wagon
text: Blesses a wagon train before it leaves the gate. The caravan travels a little faster and is less likely to be found by raiders on the road.

name: Coin Ring
text: Taps a coin or gem and listens. Counterfeit coin rings flat, so traders and tax collectors with this cantrip are never cheated.

name: Council Oath
text: Hallows the council chamber for one session. Any councillor who speaks a lie or answers to a hidden master glows faintly, a key tool against cult infiltration.

name: Crown of Command
text: A circlet of light flares on the caster's brow. Every few seconds, enemies around them who fail the save obey a single spoken word.

name: Emberroot Spark
text: Flicks a burning ember at a foe for steady fire damage. Thatch, tents and siege mantlets it hits start to smoulder.

name: False Banner
text: Makes a handful of defenders look like a full company on the walls. Raiders hesitate before attacking, and enemy scouts overcount the garrison.

name: Field Triage
text: A burst of steadying light over a battlefield. Every dying ally stabilises and all allies in range regain some hit points.

name: Firepot Barrage
text: Three clay pots of flame arc over a wall and shatter. The ground keeps burning for a few seconds, denying it to attackers.

name: Fog Lantern
text: A pale light that burns through magical fog. The party sees terrain and creatures around it clearly; when they return, the area they walked is revealed on the town map.

rt.fog: reveals terrain along the party's path when they report back

name: Founding Rite
material: a cornerstone and offerings worth 5,000 gp
text: A night-long rite that raises a whole new quarter: streets, wells and a ring of wall appear by dawn. It opens a new district on an empty plot.

name: Frost Snare
text: Frost bursts up from the ground in a small circle. Creatures caught take cold damage and are slowed, buying time for the back line.

name: Gate Sentinel
text: Calls a stone guardian to stand at one gate. It challenges strangers, fights raiders and never sleeps.

name: Ghostcap Haze
material: a ghostcap mushroom, which the spell consumes
text: Burns ghostcap into a drifting grey cloud. Creatures inside see the dead rising around them and may flee in terror.

name: Grave Draught
text: A breath of tomb air that sickens the living. The target cannot be healed until the chill passes, which counters enemy healers.

name: Grave Muster
text: Raises up to four foes who fell in this fight as skeletal thralls. They fight for the caster and crumble when the spell ends.

name: Hearthlight
text: A warm light settles on a hearth. Undead and shadows will not enter the room it lights, and those sleeping by it wake rested.

name: Hunting Fog
text: Rolls out a thick bank of fog that the caster's allies see through and enemies do not. Rangers love it for ambushes on raiding parties.

name: Hush of the Watch
text: Muffles footsteps, armour and campfire smoke around the party. Wandering monsters under fog are far less likely to notice them pass.

rt.fog: lowers the chance of encounters while travelling

name: Iron Bloom
text: A fist-sized iron bud bursts into a spray of shards. Good against packed goblins and wolf packs.

name: Iron Challenge
text: Calls out one enemy by name. If it fails the save it must fight the caster and takes a penalty against anyone else, pulling brutes off the healers.

name: Kindle Courage
text: A shouted word steadies up to three allies. They cannot be frightened and add a small bonus to their attacks while the caster keeps the spell up.

name: Last Report
material: a relic or remains of the dead
text: Calls the last moments out of a fallen hero's remains or keepsake. The town learns where they died, what killed them and what they saw, marked on the map.

rt.fog: reveals the site and killer of a lost hero

name: Leech Bolt
text: A dark bolt that drinks from its target. The caster gains temporary hit points equal to half the damage dealt.

name: Ley Bastion
material: three ley crystals, which the spell consumes
text: Raises a dome of ley light over the town. Siege shots and flying attackers break against it until it is worn down.

name: Ley Crystal Forge
material: a quartz seed and silver worth 300 gp
text: Coaxes a ley crystal out of a ley line node over a night of chanting. The crystal powers enchanting or a building's upkeep.

name: Ley Tap
material: a ley crystal, which the spell consumes
text: Draws power from a ley line through a crystal into a building. The building works without upkeep for a day, or a ward on the walls is restored to full strength.

name: Lichbane Seal
text: Stamps a sigil of holy law on the ground. Undead inside cannot rise again once destroyed, and a lich in the area loses the pull of its phylactery.

name: Market Glamour
text: Makes a stall's goods look finer than they are. Sales rise while the spell lasts; if a buyer sees through it, the guild hears about it.

name: Mend the Wall
text: Stone flows back into a breach. Repairs a section of wall, gate or tower damaged in a siege.

name: Mending Chorus
text: A sustained hymn that knits wounds. Allies in range regain a few hit points every couple of seconds while the caster keeps singing.

name: Mire Step
text: Turns the ground under one creature to sucking mud for a moment. A failed save roots it in place, breaking a charge.

name: Mirror Network
material: two silvered mirrors worth 500 gp each
text: Pairs a mirror in town with one hidden at a far outpost. The mayor gets a lasting live view of that spot until someone smashes the hidden mirror.

rt.fog: permanent live view of one remote site

name: Pack Rush
text: A howl that sends the caster and nearby allies surging forward. They move much faster while charging toward enemies.

name: Palisade Rise
text: Sharpened timbers erupt from the earth in a line. The palisade is permanent and can be built on like any wall section.

name: Parry Glimmer
text: A flash of force meets an incoming blow. The caster shrugs off part of one hit, a cheap trick heroes use on reflex in melee.

name: Peak Sight
text: Cast from a hilltop or tower, it lifts the fog from the surrounding land. The terrain for miles around is revealed on the town map, though not who moves there later.

rt.fog: permanently reveals terrain in a wide radius

name: Phantom Garrison
text: Lays an illusion over the whole town. Enemy scouts see crowded walls, fresh ditches and banners, and the raids they plan are sized wrong.

rt.fog: feeds false intelligence to enemy scouts

name: Plague Purge
text: A procession of smoke and prayer through one district. Every disease there is cured and a quarantined caravan is cleansed and let in.

name: Quarantine Line
text: Draws a line of salt across a road or gate. Disease cannot cross it, so a plague caravan can wait outside while healers work.

name: Rain of Iron
text: Thousands of conjured arrowheads fall on a wide area. It shreds massed infantry and siege crews alike.

name: Reagent Bloom
material: seeds of the reagent and fertiliser worth 200 gp
text: Seeds a field with rare reagents. For a season the plot yields bloodmoss, ghostcap or emberroot for the town's alchemists.

name: Rout
text: A thunderous war cry breaks the will of an army. Enemies in the area who fail flee, and a warband that loses its nerve may scatter instead of regrouping.

name: Rumor Wings
text: Plants a rumor that spreads through every tavern in town by nightfall. It can raise a hero's renown, sour the town on a councillor or draw a monster's attention.

name: Rustbloom
text: Red rust races through one metal object. Weapons crack, armour loosens, and portcullis chains or ram heads weaken under siege.

name: Commissioned Scrying
text: The town pays a caster to watch a far place. For the duration the mayor sees live activity at one site under fog: who is there and what they are doing.

rt.fog: temporary live view of one site

name: Sealed Accord
text: Binds a trade contract with a drop of ink from each party. Whoever breaks it is struck with misfortune, so merchant houses pay well for the casting.

name: Shadow Courier
text: Summons a shadow-bird that carries a letter or a small parcel home through the fog. It cannot be shot down by ordinary archers.

rt.fog: carries a full written report or a small item back to town

name: Shieldwall Oath
text: Allies standing shoulder to shoulder with the caster lock shields. They resist piercing damage and cannot be pushed back while they hold the line.

name: Siege Shot
text: A boulder of force arcs from the walls. Deals double damage to siege engines, barricades and buildings.

name: Signal Pyre
text: Lights a pillar of coloured smoke visible from the town walls. The mayor learns where the party is and which colour code they chose: found, fighting or fleeing.

rt.fog: reveals the party's position and a coded status

name: Snapline
text: Strings a glowing cord between two points. The first enemies to cross it are knocked flat, perfect for gate ambushes.

name: Sparkfletch
text: The caster's arrows and bolts crackle as they leave the string. Each hit deals extra lightning damage while the spell holds.

name: Spell-Slot Message
text: A hero in the field spends a spell slot to send the mayor a short report. This is the one way to hear from a party under fog before it returns.

rt.fog: a short message from a party in the field

name: Stampede Spirits
text: A herd of spectral elk thunders out in a line. Creatures in the path are trampled and knocked flat.

name: Storm Lattice
text: Lightning arcs between three points the caster picks. Creatures that cross or stand in the lattice take lightning damage each time.

name: Sunspear Fall
text: A spear of sunlight drops from the sky onto a point. Undead caught in it are also stunned for a moment, making it a favourite against the lich's vanguard.

name: Tavern Hearsay
text: The caster sits in a tavern and lets the talk wash over them. They learn the three loudest rumors in town and whether each one is true.

name: Tavern Tune
text: A catchy tune that lifts a room. Patrons in earshot spend a little more and spread the caster's name a little further.

name: Thornspit
text: Spits a volley of hooked thorns. A target that fails the save is slowed for a few seconds, which lets archers kite brutes.

name: Treasury Seal
material: a wax seal and 10 gp of silver dust
text: Seals a strongbox, vault door or ledger. Anyone who opens it without the mayor's word is marked with a glowing brand the watch can see.

name: Triple Flask
material: one reagent each of emberroot, bloodmoss and wardsalt
text: Conjures three alchemist's flasks and hurls them at separate points: fire, acid and frost. Each bursts in a small cloud of its element.

name: Turncoat
text: Up to four enemies who fail the save believe they serve the caster. A charmed siege crew will happily turn its catapult on its own camp.

name: Wardsalt Circle
text: Scatters wardsalt in a ring around the caster. Undead and fiends cannot step into it, and those forced in are burned with radiant light.

name: Wardstone
material: a carved stone and salt worth 50 gp
text: Turns a boundary stone into a ward. Raiders and monsters crossing the ward are revealed to the town, even under fog.

name: Watchtower Eye
text: Enchants the brazier atop a tower. The tower's sight radius doubles and its lookouts see through mist and darkness until dawn.

name: Waymark
text: Leaves a faint sigil on a stone or tree. Any party that carries the caster's map can find the mark again, and it shows on the town map once reported.

rt.fog: pins a point the party has visited
